scope: Synthetic SQLite source and new disposable local PostgreSQL 16.13 only. The live Eva1 service and its SQLite file were not opened, copied or changed.

checks.name: actual disposable database trial, including refused second import
checks.environment: new automatically removed PostgreSQL 16.13-alpine container and new local eva2_legacy_memory_trial_ database
checks.command: EVA2_LEGACY_MEMORY_TRIAL_DSN=<temporary local disposable DSN> PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q -s tests/postgres/test_legacy_memory_trial_tool.py tests/application/test_legacy_memory_trial.py tests/tools/test_run_legacy_memory_trial.py

proven: The selected rows are read from a consistent SQLite backup API snapshot, not directly from a changing live database file.
The snapshot must be a private 0600 file in a private local directory and is removed at scope exit.
The target trial DSN is restricted to local PostgreSQL and an eva2_legacy_memory_trial_ database name.

The target's normal tenant/install privacy scope is set before inspection; any pre-existing source event, fact assertion or current-fact pointer for that scope rejects the trial before a second memory write.
A selected synthetic record remains legacy_unverified and restricted and does not enter ordinary recall.
not_proven: No actual Eva1 memory label was selected or imported.
No normal recall, live Eva2 deployment, Telegram interaction or user acceptance was tested.
This does not authorize copying all Eva1 memories or mapping a legacy person label to an Eva2 person.
